:::{#exm-overall-agreement}
#### Overall agreement for the COVID-19 test

For the agreement table of @exm-agreement-table-covid,
the overall agreement (@def-overall-agreement) is:

$$
\ba
p_o
&= \frac{693 + 9{,}207}{10{,}000}
&& \text{(definition of } p_o \text{, with the table's counts)} \\
&= \frac{9{,}900}{10{,}000}
&& \text{(add)} \\
&= 0.99
&& \text{(divide)}
\ea
$$ {#eq-exm-overall-agreement}

:::
